$comment: Every database CodeFlow can reach and what each one needs to be reached. Read by both halves: datasource/catalog.rs compiles it in, src/lib/db/drivers.ts imports it. Edited by hand. Every downloadable file carries the hash it must have — Maven Central's sha1, or a sha256 taken when the entry was written — and the download is refused when it differs. URL templates: {field}, {field::default}, and [optional parts] kept only when every field inside has a value.
